title: Opting Out of Generative AI: a Behavioral Experiment on the Role of Education in Perplexity AI Avoidance
reasoning: The paper presents a behavioral experiment examining technology adoption and the digital divide. It analyzes how educational attainment influences the usage or avoidance of conversational AI, focusing on socio-demographic factors and technology acceptance frameworks (UTAUT2) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
